subject: ⏳ [blocked] CURSOR-HOOK ADAPTER for blocking (beforeShellExecution/beforeMCPExecution) — I CANNOT VERIFY THIS. There is no Cursor on this machine, so I would be writing and shipping an adapter I can never run, against a hook API I cannot test. That is the one thing this repo has never knowingly done. Needs either a Cursor install to test against, or an explicit decision to ship it untested and marked experimental
done_when: owner decides: provide a Cursor environment to verify against, OR explicitly accept an unverified experimental adapter with that caveat recorded in the ADR and the README
context: adr R100 (declined this as per-host adapters, knowing it lands advisory-only), Cursor hooks are a Cursor mechanism not an MCP one, and its stop hook cannot deny so forced continuation is unreachable there regardless

notes.text: decided: DROP. R100 already declined per-host adapters as a design decision, so this task was quietly re-litigating it; Cursor's stop hook cannot deny, so forced continuation is unreachable there regardless; what remains (porting secret-guard/contract-guard) is real but partial. Reasoning recorded in the ADR so re-opening costs nothing.
